proposals.evidence: DEDR3918 gives Tamil/Malayalam pattu, Toda pot and Kodagu pattï ten. Pattapu poθu preserves the p-initial numeral with rounded vowel and dental fricative in place of the stop-series comparanda. This correspondence is proposed with the exact θ retained, not normalized to t. Whole-article family membership is proposed; local contact and exact sound history remain subject to review. No higher numeral components or upstream cognacy labels are treated as independent proof. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR4985: Malayalam mula and Kannada/Kodagu mole denote breast, alongside Tamil mulai. Pattapu mola closely matches this simple stem. The separate ed̪uɹumāɹu breast response is not assigned by this analysis; the article’s explicit Badaga-to-Kota loan statement does not establish a Pattapu donor. Whole-article family membership is proposed; inheritance versus local transmission remains subject to review. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR1459: Kannada kāya/kāyi and Telugu kāya denote unripe or green fruit, alongside Tamil kāy. Pattapu kāya has the same long-vowel stem but its elicited gloss is the broader fruit; that semantic difference remains explicit. Compounds containing kāya are not included. Whole-article family membership is proposed; inheritance versus local transmission remains subject to review.
